title: Mujrayi qalq me in aankho ne kya kya
body:
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
Par Kahi'n Sibte, Payambar Sa Naa, Aaqaa Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Maine Dekhaa Aalam-E Shah Ko, Aboda E-Khoo'n
Maine Naize Pe Sar-E Dilbar-E Zehra Dekha
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Maine Dekha Ali Asghar Ka Galaa Khoon Me Tarr
Maine Abbas Ko, Rethi Pe, Tadapta Dekha
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Gatthdi ShaheDee'n Pusht Pa Laaye Jis Me
Maine Tukde Huve, Qasim Ka Saraapa Dekha
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Gir Pade Sibte Nabi, Thaam Ke Haatho'n Se Jigar
Ali Akbar Ko Jo Rethi Pe Tadaptha Dekha Aa
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Berida Khalq Ne Us Bibi Ke Sar Ko Dekha
Jiski Maadar Ka, Kisi Ne Na Janaaza Dekha Aa
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye Kyo'n Ho Na Gayi, Kor Ke, In Aankho'n Ne
Qaid Khaane Me Sakina Ka, Janaaza Dekha Aa
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulm Aye Mujrayee Sajjad Ne, Kya Kya Dekha
Ghar Lutaa, Qaid Huve, Baap Ka Laasha Dekha
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Boli Yeh Zainab-E Muztar, Ke Khuda Khair Kare
Raat Ko Khwaab Me, Uriyaan Sar-E Zehra Dekha
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaake Zainab Ne, Madine Me Kaha, Sughra Se
Kahoo'n Kis Moo Se Ke Pardes Me, Kya Kya Dekha
Mujrayee Khalq Me, In Aankhon Ne, Kya Kya Dekhaa
